newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close lower in apathetic market.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close lower in apathetic market.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed slightly lower in shallow trade with investors staying away from an apathetic market, traders said.
"The market was tedious -- no gas, and with no good news nor bad news to kickstart it," said Gonzalo Alonso of Activalores.

The market's leading 19-share index slipped 0.35 percent to close at 6,616.52 points as 31.95 million shares worth 2.81 billion bolivars ($5.85 million) traded, according to the exchange's preliminary figures.
Among total traded issues, 21 fell, 13 rose and eight closed flat. Merinvest's composite index, meanwhile, dropped 0.26 percent at 100.93.
Corimon B stock was the busiest and finished 1.67 percent up at 9.15 bolivars, with Activalores buying 15.44 of the 17.86 million shares traded. Alonso refused to explain his brokerage's move.
Most traders predicted a dull, boring week as the market maintained a wait-and-see attitude toward developments on the economic and political fronts.
